failure_reason: Category structure for Lowe's dedicated 'Animal & Pet Care' department (https://www.lowes.com/c/Animal-pet-care) was recovered live via the department landing page's embedded __PRELOADED_STATE__.taxonomy JSON (fetched successfully with curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131_android after safari17_2_ios/18_0_ios/chrome124/chrome133a all returned 403; the JSON's own 'isBot' flag was true, meaning Lowe's served this as a bot response, but it still carried the genuine taxonomy.subcategories array). However every individual /pl/ listing (PLP) URL under that department returned a hard Akamai block: 'Access Denied' (Edgesuite error page) via curl_cffi across 6 profiles (safari17_2_ios, safari18_0_ios, chrome124, firefox133, edge99, chrome131_android) and again via Playwright headless Chromium (same literal 'Access Denied' Edgesuite body). This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's documented finding for this exact site/IP class: /pl/ paths are path-pattern blocked by Akamai while some /c/ department pages remain reachable. No exact product count could be verified for any sub-category as a result; every row therefore carries qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a guessed number, per the 'a null is a correct answer' rule.
notes: Assigned site_url (https://www.lowes.com/c/Home-decor) itself contains no genuine Pet Care category (checked the live-fetched Home-decor page HTML for any 'pet' nav/category mention -- none found, only an unrelated 'safe for kids and pets' blind-marketing blurb). Checked the Lowe's homepage instead, which live-links a marketing tile 'Shop Animal and Pet Care Products' -> /c/Animal-pet-care, confirming Lowe's runs a dedicated Pet Care department elsewhere on the same domain/company; per the brief this is recorded under this company's Pet Care result rather than treated as absent. Fetched /c/Animal-pet-care live and extracted its full department taxonomy: 15 subcategories total. Excluded 'Livestock Supplies' (farm/livestock animal supplies -- chicken coops, poultry, troughs -- not companion-pet care, out of Pet Care scope per project precedent). Kept the other 14 as Pet Care leaves. 'Terrariums & Habitats' kept under Tier-2 contextual rule (generic housing name sitting directly under the pet-specific 'Animal & Pet Care' parent = reptile/small-pet housing). 'Pet Toys & Treats' and 'Pet Vitamins & Supplements' flagged per the PET CONSUMABLE policy gap since their names indicate a consumables component (treats/supplements) bundled with or alongside genuine Pet Care items; recorded rather than dropped. No medical/veterinary-named category was present in the taxonomy (no 'Pet Medicine', 'Pet Pharmacy', 'Veterinary' branch found); 'Pet Grooming & Health' was evaluated as a grooming category by name and kept without a medical flag, though its exact contents could not be inspected due to the /pl/ block. robots.txt fetched and checked in full for a Claude-specific disallow (anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot) -- none present; only one generic 'User-agent: *' block with no full-site disallow, so Claude-in-Chrome would have been permitted, but was not needed since curl_cffi/Playwright already reached the department page and the /pl/ block is a hard Akamai edge deny (403/Access Denied) that a headless browser also failed to pass, not a JS-challenge that browser automation could plausibly clear -- escalating to Claude-in-Chrome for the same hard-denied path was judged not worth the burn given the identical block was already exhaustively documented for this site in the prior Home-Decor pass. is_group left false for all rows: the department taxonomy returned a flat list of 15 named subcategory PLPs with no further nested children exposed in the JSON, so none of them could be confirmed as further grouping nodes.
